channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: Divine intimacy
item.description: In John 14:10-11, Jesus makes a staggering statement. The Father dwells in the Son, but also, at one and the same time, the Son dwells in the Father. More than this, the Spirit too is in both the Father and the Son as they are within him.

item.title: Ada R. Habershon: A hidden gem
item.description: Here is an example of the way the Lord uses his people to bring about his purposes.

item.title: A pause is not enough, we must end these transgender experiments on kids
item.description: We need to press the STOP button, not the pause button, on these harmful gender experiments on our children.

item.title: Government won’t tell schools to end kids gender transitions
item.description: The government has issued draft guidance for dealing with transgender issues in schools and still refuses to put an end to gender transitioning.

item.title: Yemen: Crackdown against Christians
item.description: The church in Yemen is facing an unprecedented crackdown, with more than 50 believers arrested in recent months, according to the religious freedom agency Open Doors UK.

item.title: Ukraine: Continued support amid bitter winter
item.description: US-based Christian charity Mission to Ukraine has been delivering essential provisions to families in Ukraine. One of the most bitter winters on record, coupled with the continued struggle against the Russian invasion, has left millions of families in great difficulty.

item.title: The ‘Quiet Revival’ may be quiet, but is it a revival?
item.description: You may have heard a fair bit about the so-called ‘Quiet Revival’, a surge of interest in Christianity and church-going, especially among young adults

item.title: At last, a police officer defends a Christian preacher from a Muslim crowd
item.description: Thank God for this female police officer willing to defend a Christian street preacher from a crowd of Muslim men.

item.title: PM links home education with extremism, but the House of Lords waters down regulation plans
item.description: The Prime Minister, Sir Keir Starmer, has outraged home-educators by linking their rights and freedoms with extremism.

item.title: Follow God at all costs: Lessons drawn from life of Caleb Reformation and Revival conference
item.description: The history of this conference stretches back many years, surviving while others have faded.
